taste:
This is a smaller steak plate with rich, savoury beef flavour and a satisfyingly firm texture. The rump is grilled to your liking, so state your preferred doneness when ordering. Its appeal is the combination of a modest steak portion and familiar accompaniments, rather than a large serving of meat.

Golden chips, sweet peas, a grilled tomato and a flat mushroom round out the plate. The peas bring sweetness against the beef’s savoury character, while the full set of sides keeps it recognisably a classic steak meal. It suits an appetite that wants steak without choosing a larger cut.

Mixed Grill and Large Mixed Grill are other options to compare if appetite is your main concern.
